IKV provenance: AMD FidelityFX SDK (FSR 3.1.4 upscaler + frame generation subset)
================================================================

Upstream
  Repository  https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK
  Tag         v1.1.4 (release notes: FSR 3.1.4; sdk/include/FidelityFX/host/ffx_fsr3upscaler.h VERSION 3.1.4)
  Commit      c6efa6bf7f2027b3ec94f28578bb5965eabb9e55
  Archive     https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK/archive/refs/tags/v1.1.4.tar.gz
              sha256 25c46398a656150397597f78d44bf7cb445e9e177dd116b309bbfdf50d50cc9f (198086086 bytes, fetched
              2026-10-10; GitHub tag archives are not guaranteed byte-stable, the per-file hashes below are authoritative)
  License     MIT, LICENSE.txt (installed as share/doc/<project>/third_party/FidelityFX-SDK-LICENSE.txt)

Selection
  What FSR 3.1.4 upscaling and frame generation need on the Vulkan backend: the fsr3upscaler, frameinterpolation and
  opticalflow host components, the VK backend (ffx_vk.cpp), their GLSL passes and gpu headers (fsr3upscaler, fsr1, spd,
  core, frameinterpolation, opticalflow), and the shared host helpers. Paths are kept as in the upstream tree. The
  Win32-only FrameInterpolationSwapchain, the fsr3 wrapper component, ffx-api, samples, prebuilt DLLs and other effects are
  not vendored: IKV owns the swapchain, pacing and presentation of generated frames (src/renderer_vk.cpp).
  Frame interpolation/optical flow files added 2026-10-10 from the same archive (same commit).

IKV-owned files around it (not upstream)
  tools/ffx_fsr3_blobs.py             replaces the Windows-only FidelityFX_SC: glslc SPIR-V for the 10 FSR3 upscaler passes x
                                      (HDR, sharpen), the 11 frame-interpolation passes (render-resolution unjittered motion,
                                      non-inverted depth) and the 7 optical-flow passes (SDR) + SPIR-V descriptor reflection into
                                      build-*/generated/ikv_fsr3_blobs.h
  third_party/ikv-ffx-posix/ikv_ffx_posix.h  force-included CRT stand-ins (POSIX: _countof, wcscpy_s, strcpy_s, sprintf_s;
                                      MinGW-w64: swprintf_s), missing std headers, FFX_SDK_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_SIZE 1 MiB
                                      (wchar_t is 4 bytes on Linux)
  include/ikv/fsr_vk.hpp, src/fsr_vk.cpp  IKV wrapper: blob accessor, capability clamp, shared resources, upscale dispatch,
                                      optical flow + frame interpolation contexts/dispatch (interpolate())

Local patches (each marked "IKV local patch" in the source)
  1. sdk/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp, findMemoryTypeIndex: skip memory types with VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_COHERENT_BIT_AMD
     unless that property is requested. Upstream picked the last DEVICE_LOCAL type, which on RADV is the AMD
     device-coherent/uncached type: VUID-vkAllocateMemory-deviceCoherentMemory-02790 (feature not enabled) and
     uncached memory for every FSR resource.
  2. sdk/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp, ffxGetScratchMemorySizeVK + CreateBackendContextVK: scratch sub-arrays are aligned
     to alignof(BackendContext_VK::EffectContext) (alignas(32)) instead of 4 bytes, the first one aligned up after the
     backend context, and the size function adds that slack. With 4-byte offsets GCC -O2 emitted aligned SSE stores
     (movaps) into pEffectContexts and RelWithDebInfo clients crashed (SIGSEGV) creating the FSR context.
  3. sdk/src/components/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler.cpp: a failed ffxFsr3UpscalerContextCreate released nothing; the
     backend context, resources and pipelines created before the failure leaked (VUID-vkDestroyDevice-device-05137,
     587 objects). context->device is now set only after the backend context exists (it was set before the version
     check) and ffxFsr3UpscalerContextCreate calls the existing idempotent fsr3upscalerRelease on failure.
  4. sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler_callbacks_glsl.h: rw_luma_history storage format
     qualifier rgba8 -> rgba16f, the format of the FSR3UPSCALER_LumaHistory1/2 resources (R16G16B16A16_FLOAT). The
     mismatch makes every load/store undefined in Vulkan (validation Undefined-Value-StorageImage-FormatMismatch).
  5. sdk/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp, CreateBackendContextVK: the global descriptor pool lists 6 pool sizes but passed
     poolSizeCount = 5, dropping VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER; frame interpolation's counters are storage buffers
     (validation WARNING-CoreValidation-AllocateDescriptorSets-WrongType). Now _countof(poolSizes).
  6. sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu/frameinterpolation/ffx_frameinterpolation_callbacks_glsl.h, LoadOpticalFlowConfidence:
     ffxFrameInterpolationDispatch never registers an optical-flow confidence resource (FSR 3.1 optical flow has none), so
     r_optical_flow_confidence was never written (VUID-vkCmdDispatch-None-08114; D3D12 reads a null SRV as 0). Returns the
     null-SRV value 0 without declaring the texture; its only caller computes a weight it never uses.
